description: This file defines the ConfigTranslationMapperList class, a Drupal controller responsible for managing and rendering a list of configuration translation mappers grouped by weight, including building table headers, rows, and operation links.

classes.name: ConfigTranslationMapperList
classes.description: A Drupal controller class that manages and displays a list of configuration translation mappers, grouped by weight, with methods for rendering table headers, rows, and operation links.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the mappers array.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the class using the container to get mappers.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Builds and returns a renderable array representing the table of mappers, grouped and sorted by weight and label.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Creates a render array for a single mapper row, including label and operations.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Creates the header row for the mapper listing table.

methods.name: buildOperations
methods.description: Builds a list of operation links for a given mapper, sorted by weight.
